Georgia · Rule 150-8-.05

Georgia’s dental waterline rule, in plain English.

What the Georgia Board of Dentistry asks of every practice’s dental unit water, in four points.

Book a 15-minute call

The rule in four points

  • Quarterly

    Test quarterly

    Every dental unit waterline, every quarter. Up to 10 lines may be pooled into one sample, if you record how many.

  • 30 days

    Test again after repairs

    Within 30 days of a repair or a change to the plumbing.

  • ≤ 500

    Meet 500 CFU/mL

    The EPA drinking-water standard. A failed test calls for immediate remedial action.

  • 5 years

    Keep records 5 years

    A log of test dates and who did each test, and/or reports from an independent testing company.

What to do

  1. Put a quarterly test on the calendar for every dental unit.
  2. After any repair or plumbing change, test again within 30 days.
  3. Keep every log entry and test report for five years.

Summary only, not legal advice. Rule 150-8-.05, as amended April 30, 2026. Read the official text: Georgia Board of Dentistry, Chapter 150-8.
